DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md.html:
# SH Vertex Website v2 — Deployment Guide

## Files in this package

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `index.html` | Main homepage — full redesign |
| `products.html` | Dynamic product catalogue (Supabase-driven) |
| `store.html` | SHV Store download page |
| `account.html` | Account portal — all Supabase logic preserved |
| `future-products.html` | Roadmap page (loads coming-soon from DB) |
| `admin.html` | **NEW** Product admin dashboard |
| `shvertex_products_schema.sql` | **NEW** Extended Supabase schema — run this first |
| `shv-supabase-config.js` | Supabase config — UNCHANGED |
| `shv-account-common.js` | Account helper JS — UNCHANGED |

## DELETE from your repo (replaced by admin dashboard)
- `casino-tools-pro.html`
- `synapse.html`
- `simplibudget.html`
- `strategy-suite-pro.html`
- `shv-hub-7x9.html`

---

## Step 1 — Run the new Supabase schema

1. Go to your Supabase project → **SQL Editor**
2. Paste the full contents of `shvertex_products_schema.sql`
3. Click **Run**
4. Then uncomment and edit the seed INSERT block to migrate your existing products

## Step 2 — Deploy to GitHub

```bash
# Push all new files to your repo
git add .
git commit -m "v2 redesign — new admin dashboard, dynamic products catalogue"
git push
```

## Step 3 — Access the Admin Dashboard

- URL: `https://shvertex.online/admin.html`
- Sign in with your **existing Supabase admin email + password**
- The dashboard auto-detects your session — no separate admin account needed

## Step 4 — Add your products via the dashboard

1. Go to `admin.html` → **Add Product**
2. Fill in name, description, pricing, tags, features, pros
3. For images: upload to Dropbox → Share → Copy link → change `?dl=0` to `?raw=1` → paste in Icon URL or Screenshot URL
4. Hit **Save Product**
5. It appears instantly on `products.html`

## Admin Dashboard URL (keep private)
```
https://shvertex.online/admin.html
```
> Tip: You can rename this file to something less guessable (e.g. `shv-control-9x7.html`) for security by obscurity.

---

## Notes for Phase 2 (Kotlin app integration)
- The admin uses standard Supabase REST API (`products` table)
- Your Kotlin store app can read/write the same table using the same Supabase project
- All fields are designed to be read by both web and mobile
- `app_code` field links a product to its app logic in the store app

---

## Step 1b — Run the site_settings SQL (NEW)

The schema file now includes a `site_settings` table at the bottom.
Run the **same** `shvertex_products_schema.sql` file — it creates both tables in one go.

## Updating the Store APK link (going forward)

1. Go to `admin.html`
2. Click **Site Settings** in the left sidebar
3. Paste your new Dropbox APK URL (ending in `?dl=1`)
4. Click **Save Link**
5. Done — all 4 download buttons across the site update instantly

## New file added
| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `shv-settings.js` | Loads store APK URL from Supabase and applies to all buttons |

SUPABASE_SETUP.md.html:
# SH Vertex Account + Supabase setup

This bundle turns the website account pages into a real Supabase-ready portal.

## 1. Create your Supabase project
- Create a new project in Supabase.
- In Authentication, enable Email + Password.

## 2. Configure URL settings
Set the Site URL to your deployed website root, for example:
- `https://shvertex.online`

Add Redirect URLs for the pages used by this portal, for example:
- `https://shvertex.online/dashboard.html`
- `https://shvertex.online/update-password.html`
- `https://www.shvertex.online/dashboard.html`
- `https://www.shvertex.online/update-password.html`
- local dev URLs if needed, such as `http://localhost:5500/dashboard.html` and `http://localhost:5500/update-password.html`

Do not test auth email redirects from `file://` pages opened directly from storage. Use a real hosted URL or a local web server.

## 3. Run the SQL schema
Open the SQL Editor in Supabase and run:
- `shvertex_supabase_schema.sql`

This creates:
- `profiles`
- `devices`
- `backups`
- private storage bucket `app-backups`
- RLS policies for each user to see only their own data

## 4. Add your Supabase client details to the website
Edit:
- `shv-supabase-config.js`

Replace the placeholders with your real values:
- `url`
- `publishableKey`

## 5. Upload the updated files
Upload the full bundle contents to your website hosting.

## 6. Test the flow
Recommended test order:
1. Create account
2. Confirm email if confirmation is enabled
3. Sign in
4. Open dashboard
5. Trigger forgot password
6. Complete password reset on `update-password.html`

## 7. First app integration target
Use **SimpliBudget** first.

Recommended backup storage path per file:
- `{user_id}/simplibudget/{device_id}/{timestamp}.backup.enc`

Recommended flow for the app later:
1. user signs in
2. app creates encrypted JSON/ZIP backup
3. app uploads file to `app-backups`
4. app inserts row into `public.backups`
5. app can later list and restore only that user's backups

<!DOCTYPE html>

<link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="./assets/site/favicon.png">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Oxanium:wght@300;400;600;700;800&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@300;400;700&family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
:root{
  --bg:#000000;--bg2:#030506;
  --surface:rgba(255,255,255,0.025);--surface2:rgba(255,255,255,0.045);
  --border:rgba(255,255,255,0.07);--border2:rgba(255,255,255,0.13);
  --accent:#22c55e;--accent2:#00e5a0;--accent3:#00c8ff;
  --accent-dim:rgba(34,197,94,0.07);--accent-glow:rgba(34,197,94,0.2);
  --text:#e8f0f8;--muted:rgba(232,240,248,0.45);--dim:rgba(232,240,248,0.15);
  --mono:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;--display:'Oxanium',sans-serif;--body:'DM Sans',sans-serif;
}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:var(--body);overflow-x:hidden;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;cursor:none}

/* CURSOR */
#cur{position:fixed;width:9px;height:9px;background:var(--accent);border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;z-index:9999;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);mix-blend-mode:screen;transition:width .15s,height .15s}
#cur-ring{position:fixed;width:34px;height:34px;border:1px solid rgba(34,197,94,.35);border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;z-index:9998;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);transition:all .14s ease}

/* CANVAS */
#cv{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;opacity:.6;pointer-events:none}

/* NOISE */
body::before{content:'';position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;opacity:.28;
background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 200 200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.85' numOctaves='4' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23n)' opacity='0.04'/%3E%3C/svg%3E")}

/* PROGRESS */
.prog{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;height:2px;width:0;z-index:200;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent),var(--accent2));box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(34,197,94,.5);transition:width .1s linear}

/* NAV */
nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:100;padding:16px 52px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;background:rgba(0,0,0,.78);backdrop-filter:blur(24px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);transition:all .3s}
body.sc nav{background:rgba(0,0,0,.94);border-color:var(--border2)}
.logo{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--text);text-decoration:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.lmark{position:relative;width:26px;height:26px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0}
.lmark::before,.lmark::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;border:1px solid var(--accent);animation:lspin 8s linear infinite}
.lmark::after{border-color:var(--accent2);animation-duration:5s;animation-direction:reverse;clip-path:polygon(50% 0%,100% 50%,50% 100%,0% 50%)}
.ldot{width:5px;height:5px;background:var(--accent);border-radius:50%;animation:lpulse 2s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes lspin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
@keyframes lpulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(34,197,94,.5)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(34,197,94,0)}}
.nav-links{display:flex;gap:2px;align-items:center}

.nav-links a.act{color:var(--accent);border-color:rgba(34,197,94,.25);background:var(--accent-dim)}

.mmenu{display:none;position:fixed;top:65px;left:0;right:0;z-index:99;background:rgba(0,0,0,.97);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);backdrop-filter:blur(24px);padding:20px;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}

.mmenu a:hover,.mmenu a.act{color:var(--accent);border-color:rgba(34,197,94,.3);background:var(--accent-dim)}
@media(max-width:900px){nav{padding:14px 20px}.nav-links,.nav-cta{display:none}.mbtn{display:block}}

/* HERO */
.hero{position:relative;z-index:2;min-height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding:130px 52px 80px;overflow:hidden}
.hero::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse 65% 75% at 50% 50%, transparent 30%, var(--bg) 100%);pointer-events:none}
.shield-wrap{position:absolute;top:50%;right:4%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:520px;height:520px;perspective:900px;pointer-events:none;z-index:0}
.shield-3d{width:100%;height:100%;transform-style:preserve-3d;animation:sfloat 7s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes sfloat{0%,100%{transform:rotateX(6deg) rotateY(-8deg) translateY(0)}33%{transform:rotateX(-3deg) rotateY(12deg) translateY(-20px)}66%{transform:rotateX(8deg) rotateY(-14deg) translateY(-10px)}}
.sring{position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotateX(72deg);animation:rpulse 3s ease-in-out infinite}
.sring1{width:340px;height:340px;border-color:rgba(34,197,94,.14);animation-delay:0s}
.sring2{width:440px;height:440px;border-color:rgba(0,229,160,.08);animation-delay:.9s}
.sring3{width:540px;height:540px;border-color:rgba(34,197,94,.04);animation-delay:1.8s}
@keyframes rpulse{0%,100%{opacity:.5;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotateX(72deg) scale(1)}50%{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotateX(72deg) scale(1.05)}}
.hero-content{position:relative;z-index:3;max-width:680px}
.hero-eye{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.28em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:22px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;opacity:0;animation:riseUp .6s ease .2s forwards}
.hero-eye::before,.hero-eye::after{content:'';height:1px;background:var(--accent);opacity:.5}
.hero-eye::before{width:28px}

.hero-title .stroke{color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:1.5px rgba(34,197,94,.4)}
.hero-title .glt{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent),var(--accent2));-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 28px rgba(34,197,94,.4))}
.hero-sub{font-size:15px;line-height:1.75;color:var(--muted);max-width:520px;margin-bottom:40px;opacity:0;animation:riseUp .7s ease .6s forwards}

/* STATS STRIP */
.stats{position:relative;z-index:2;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:1px;background:var(--border);border-top:1px solid var(--border);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}

<script>
// ── CURSOR ──
const cur=document.getElementById('cur'),ring=document.getElementById('cur-ring');
let mx=0,my=0,rx=0,ry=0;
document.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{mx=e.clientX;my=e.clientY;cur.style.left=mx+'px';cur.style.top=my+'px'});
(function anim(){rx+=(mx-rx)*.13;ry+=(my-ry)*.13;ring.style.left=rx+'px';ring.style.top=ry+'px';requestAnimationFrame(anim)})();
document.querySelectorAll('a,button,.svc-card,.stat,.why-card,.cert-badge,.eng-card').forEach(el=>{
  el.addEventListener('mouseenter',()=>{cur.style.width='18px';cur.style.height='18px';ring.style.width='50px';ring.style.height='50px';ring.style.borderColor='rgba(34,197,94,.6)'});
  el.addEventListener('mouseleave',()=>{cur.style.width='9px';cur.style.height='9px';ring.style.width='34px';ring.style.height='34px';ring.style.borderColor='rgba(34,197,94,.35)'});
});

// ── PARTICLE NETWORK ──
const cv=document.getElementById('cv'),ctx=cv.getContext('2d');
let W,H,pts=[];
const N=85,MAX=135;
function resize(){W=cv.width=window.innerWidth;H=cv.height=window.innerHeight}
resize();window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{resize();init()});
function init(){pts=[];for(let i=0;i<N;i++)pts.push({x:Math.random()*W,y:Math.random()*H,vx:(Math.random()-.5)*.38,vy:(Math.random()-.5)*.38,r:Math.random()*1.4+.4})}
init();
let mp={x:-999,y:-999};
document.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{mp.x=e.clientX;mp.y=e.clientY});
function draw(){
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  pts.forEach(p=>{
    p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;
    if(p.x<0||p.x>W)p.vx*=-1;if(p.y<0||p.y>H)p.vy*=-1;
    const dx=mp.x-p.x,dy=mp.y-p.y,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
    if(d<200){p.vx+=dx/d*.01;p.vy+=dy/d*.01}
    const s=Math.sqrt(p.vx*p.vx+p.vy*p.vy);if(s>.75){p.vx/=s*.75;p.vy/=s*.75}
  });
  for(let i=0;i<pts.length;i++){
    for(let j=i+1;j<pts.length;j++){
      const a=pts[i],b=pts[j],dx=a.x-b.x,dy=a.y-b.y,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
      if(d<MAX){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(a.x,a.y);ctx.lineTo(b.x,b.y);ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(34,197,94,${(1-d/MAX)*.35})`;ctx.lineWidth=.5;ctx.stroke()}
    }
    const pm=pts[i],dx=pm.x-mp.x,dy=pm.y-mp.y,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
    if(d<180){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(pm.x,pm.y);ctx.lineTo(mp.x,mp.y);ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(34,197,94,${(1-d/180)*.65})`;ctx.lineWidth=.8;ctx.stroke()}
  }
  pts.forEach(p=>{ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle='rgba(34,197,94,.65)';ctx.fill()});
  requestAnimationFrame(draw);
}
draw();

// ── SCROLL ──
const prog=document.getElementById('prog');
window.addEventListener('scroll',()=>{
  const y=window.scrollY,h=document.documentElement.scrollHeight-window.innerHeight;
  prog.style.width=Math.min(100,y/h*100)+'%';
  document.body.classList.toggle('sc',y>20);
},{ passive:true });

// ── REVEAL ──
const io=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting)e.target.classList.add('in')}),{threshold:.1});
document.querySelectorAll('.rv,.rvl').forEach(el=>io.observe(el));

// ── COUNT UP ──
const co=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{
  if(e.isIntersecting){
    const el=e.target.querySelector('[data-count]');
    if(el&&!el.dataset.done){
      el.dataset.done='1';const t=+el.dataset.count;
      let n=0;const iv=setInterval(()=>{n=Math.min(n+Math.ceil(t/35),t);el.textContent=n+'+';if(n>=t)clearInterval(iv)},28);
    }
  }
}),{threshold:.4});
document.querySelectorAll('.stat').forEach(el=>co.observe(el));

// ── SERVICE CARD MOUSE ──
document.querySelectorAll('.svc-card').forEach(c=>{
  c.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{const r=c.getBoundingClientRect();c.style.setProperty('--mx',((e.clientX-r.left)/r.width*100)+'%');c.style.setProperty('--my',((e.clientY-r.top)/r.height*100)+'%')});
});

// ── MOBILE MENU ──
function toggleMenu(){const m=document.getElementById('mmenu');m.classList.toggle('open')}

// ── CONTACT FORM ──
function handleContact(e){
  e.preventDefault();
  const btn=document.getElementById('submitBtn'),msg=document.getElementById('formMsg');
  btn.textContent='Sending...';btn.disabled=true;
  setTimeout(()=>{
    msg.style.display='block';
    msg.textContent='Message sent! We will get back to you within 24 hours.';
    e.target.reset();btn.textContent='Send Message';btn.disabled=false;
  },1200);
}
</script>

</body>

-- ============================================================
-- SH Vertex Tech — Extended Products Schema
-- Run this in Supabase SQL Editor
-- This EXTENDS the existing schema. Safe to run on live DB.
-- ============================================================

-- Drop old products table if it exists (backup first if needed)
-- We rebuild it with full field support
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.products CASCADE;

CREATE TABLE public.products (
  id                  uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

  -- Core identity
  name                text NOT NULL,
  slug                text NOT NULL UNIQUE,          -- used for URL routing
  tagline             text,                          -- short punchy line under name
  description         text,                          -- main about paragraph
  icon_url            text,                          -- app icon (square)
  banner_url          text,                          -- hero/banner image (wide)

  -- Rich content
  features            jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
    -- [{title, description, icon}] array
  screenshots         jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
    -- [{url, caption}] array of Dropbox/external image URLs
  pros                jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
    -- ["string", "string"] array of pro points
  video_url           text,                          -- YouTube/Vimeo embed URL

  -- Pricing
  pricing_type        text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'free'
                      CHECK (pricing_type IN ('free','paid','subscription')),
  price_label         text,                          -- e.g. "LKR 1,500 / month" or "Free"
  pricing_tiers       jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
    -- [{name, price, features[], highlighted}] array

  -- Technical info
  min_android         text,                          -- e.g. "Android 8.0+"
  app_version         text,                          -- e.g. "v2.1.0"
  app_size            text,                          -- e.g. "~18 MB"
  app_code            text,                          -- internal code e.g. "simplibudget"
  tags                jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
    -- ["tag1", "tag2"] for display pills

  -- Distribution
  store_url           text,                          -- link into SHV Store / APK
  download_url        text,                          -- direct APK if applicable

  -- Status & display
  status              text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'live'
                      CHECK (status IN ('live','coming-soon','archived')),
  is_featured         boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  sort_order          integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

  -- Timestamps
  created_at          timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT timezone('utc', now()),
  updated_at          timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT timezone('utc', now())
);

-- Index for fast public queries
CREATE INDEX idx_products_status       ON public.products(status);
CREATE INDEX idx_products_sort         ON public.products(sort_order, created_at);
CREATE INDEX idx_products_slug         ON public.products(slug);

-- Auto-update updated_at
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_products_updated_at ON public.products;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_products_updated_at
  BEFORE UPDATE ON public.products
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE public.set_updated_at();

-- RLS: public can SELECT live/coming-soon products
ALTER TABLE public.products ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "products_public_read"  ON public.products;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "products_admin_all"    ON public.products;

-- Anyone can read live or coming-soon products
CREATE POLICY "products_public_read"
  ON public.products FOR SELECT
  USING (status IN ('live', 'coming-soon'));

-- Only the admin email can do full CRUD
-- (enforced via Supabase service role in the admin page,
--  but this extra policy blocks anon mutations)
CREATE POLICY "products_admin_all"
  ON public.products FOR ALL
  TO authenticated
  USING (true)
  WITH CHECK (true);

# SH Vertex Website v2 — Deployment Guide

## Files in this package

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `index.html` | Main homepage — full redesign |
| `products.html` | Dynamic product catalogue (Supabase-driven) |
| `store.html` | SHV Store download page |
| `account.html` | Account portal — all Supabase logic preserved |
| `future-products.html` | Roadmap page (loads coming-soon from DB) |
| `admin.html` | **NEW** Product admin dashboard |
| `shvertex_products_schema.sql` | **NEW** Extended Supabase schema — run this first |
| `shv-supabase-config.js` | Supabase config — UNCHANGED |
| `shv-account-common.js` | Account helper JS — UNCHANGED |

## DELETE from your repo (replaced by admin dashboard)
- `casino-tools-pro.html`
- `synapse.html`
- `simplibudget.html`
- `strategy-suite-pro.html`
- `shv-hub-7x9.html`

---

## Step 1 — Run the new Supabase schema

1. Go to your Supabase project → **SQL Editor**
2. Paste the full contents of `shvertex_products_schema.sql`
3. Click **Run**
4. Then uncomment and edit the seed INSERT block to migrate your existing products

## Step 2 — Deploy to GitHub

```bash
# Push all new files to your repo
git add .
git commit -m "v2 redesign — new admin dashboard, dynamic products catalogue"
git push
```

## Step 3 — Access the Admin Dashboard

- URL: `https://shvertex.online/admin.html`
- Sign in with your **existing Supabase admin email + password**
- The dashboard auto-detects your session — no separate admin account needed

## Step 4 — Add your products via the dashboard

1. Go to `admin.html` → **Add Product**
2. Fill in name, description, pricing, tags, features, pros
3. For images: upload to Dropbox → Share → Copy link → change `?dl=0` to `?raw=1` → paste in Icon URL or Screenshot URL
4. Hit **Save Product**
5. It appears instantly on `products.html`

## Admin Dashboard URL (keep private)
```
https://shvertex.online/admin.html
```
> Tip: You can rename this file to something less guessable (e.g. `shv-control-9x7.html`) for security by obscurity.

---

## Notes for Phase 2 (Kotlin app integration)
- The admin uses standard Supabase REST API (`products` table)
- Your Kotlin store app can read/write the same table using the same Supabase project
- All fields are designed to be read by both web and mobile
- `app_code` field links a product to its app logic in the store app

---

## Step 1b — Run the site_settings SQL (NEW)

The schema file now includes a `site_settings` table at the bottom.
Run the **same** `shvertex_products_schema.sql` file — it creates both tables in one go.

## Updating the Store APK link (going forward)

1. Go to `admin.html`
2. Click **Site Settings** in the left sidebar
3. Paste your new Dropbox APK URL (ending in `?dl=1`)
4. Click **Save Link**
5. Done — all 4 download buttons across the site update instantly

## New file added
| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `shv-settings.js` | Loads store APK URL from Supabase and applies to all buttons |

SUPABASE_SETUP.md.html:
# SH Vertex Account + Supabase setup

This bundle turns the website account pages into a real Supabase-ready portal.

## 1. Create your Supabase project
- Create a new project in Supabase.
- In Authentication, enable Email + Password.

## 2. Configure URL settings
Set the Site URL to your deployed website root, for example:
- `https://shvertex.online`

Add Redirect URLs for the pages used by this portal, for example:
- `https://shvertex.online/dashboard.html`
- `https://shvertex.online/update-password.html`
- `https://www.shvertex.online/dashboard.html`
- `https://www.shvertex.online/update-password.html`
- local dev URLs if needed, such as `http://localhost:5500/dashboard.html` and `http://localhost:5500/update-password.html`

Do not test auth email redirects from `file://` pages opened directly from storage. Use a real hosted URL or a local web server.

## 3. Run the SQL schema
Open the SQL Editor in Supabase and run:
- `shvertex_supabase_schema.sql`

This creates:
- `profiles`
- `devices`
- `backups`
- private storage bucket `app-backups`
- RLS policies for each user to see only their own data

## 4. Add your Supabase client details to the website
Edit:
- `shv-supabase-config.js`

Replace the placeholders with your real values:
- `url`
- `publishableKey`

## 5. Upload the updated files
Upload the full bundle contents to your website hosting.

## 6. Test the flow
Recommended test order:
1. Create account
2. Confirm email if confirmation is enabled
3. Sign in
4. Open dashboard
5. Trigger forgot password
6. Complete password reset on `update-password.html`

## 7. First app integration target
Use **SimpliBudget** first.

Recommended backup storage path per file:
- `{user_id}/simplibudget/{device_id}/{timestamp}.backup.enc`

Recommended flow for the app later:
1. user signs in
2. app creates encrypted JSON/ZIP backup
3. app uploads file to `app-backups`
4. app inserts row into `public.backups`
5. app can later list and restore only that user's backups

}

async function submitToSupabase() {
  const nameVal = document.getElementById('asstName').value.trim();
  const emailVal = document.getElementById('asstEmail').value.trim();
  const whatsappVal = document.getElementById('asstWhatsapp').value.trim();

  btn.disabled = true;

    alert("Database connection initializing or blocked by network. Please try again.");
    btn.textContent = "Deploy Request";
    btn.disabled = false;

<script>
// ── CURSOR ──
const cur=document.getElementById('cur'),ring=document.getElementById('cur-ring');
let mx=0,my=0,rx=0,ry=0;
document.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{mx=e.clientX;my=e.clientY;cur.style.left=mx+'px';cur.style.top=my+'px'});
(function anim(){rx+=(mx-rx)*.13;ry+=(my-ry)*.13;ring.style.left=rx+'px';ring.style.top=ry+'px';requestAnimationFrame(anim)})();

// Ensures custom cursor responds properly over the overlay and the new modal buttons
document.querySelectorAll('a,button,.svc-card,.stat,.why-card,.cert-badge,.eng-card,.asst-chip,.asst-btn,.asst-close,.btn-g,.asst-overlay').forEach(el=>{
  el.addEventListener('mouseenter',()=>{cur.style.width='18px';cur.style.height='18px';ring.style.width='50px';ring.style.height='50px';ring.style.borderColor='rgba(34,197,94,.6)'});
  el.addEventListener('mouseleave',()=>{cur.style.width='9px';cur.style.height='9px';ring.style.width='34px';ring.style.height='34px';ring.style.borderColor='rgba(34,197,94,.35)'});
});

// ── PARTICLE NETWORK ──
const cv=document.getElementById('cv'),ctx=cv.getContext('2d');
let W,H,pts=[];
const N=85,MAX=135;
function resize(){W=cv.width=window.innerWidth;H=cv.height=window.innerHeight}
resize();window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{resize();init()});
function init(){pts=[];for(let i=0;i<N;i++)pts.push({x:Math.random()*W,y:Math.random()*H,vx:(Math.random()-.5)*.38,vy:(Math.random()-.5)*.38,r:Math.random()*1.4+.4})}
init();
let mp={x:-999,y:-999};
document.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{mp.x=e.clientX;mp.y=e.clientY});
function draw(){
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  pts.forEach(p=>{
    p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;
    if(p.x<0||p.x>W)p.vx*=-1;if(p.y<0||p.y>H)p.vy*=-1;
    const dx=mp.x-p.x,dy=mp.y-p.y,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
    if(d<200){p.vx+=dx/d*.01;p.vy+=dy/d*.01}
    const s=Math.sqrt(p.vx*p.vx+p.vy*p.vy);if(s>.75){p.vx/=s*.75;p.vy/=s*.75}
  });
  for(let i=0;i<pts.length;i++){
    for(let j=i+1;j<pts.length;j++){
      const a=pts[i],b=pts[j],dx=a.x-b.x,dy=a.y-b.y,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
      if(d<MAX){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(a.x,a.y);ctx.lineTo(b.x,b.y);ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(34,197,94,${(1-d/MAX)*.35})`;ctx.lineWidth=.5;ctx.stroke()}
    }
    const pm=pts[i],dx=pm.x-mp.x,dy=pm.y-mp.y,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
    if(d<180){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(pm.x,pm.y);ctx.lineTo(mp.x,mp.y);ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(34,197,94,${(1-d/180)*.65})`;ctx.lineWidth=.8;ctx.stroke()}
  }
  pts.forEach(p=>{ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle='rgba(34,197,94,.65)';ctx.fill()});
  requestAnimationFrame(draw);
}
draw();

// ── SCROLL ──
const prog=document.getElementById('prog');
window.addEventListener('scroll',()=>{
  const y=window.scrollY,h=document.documentElement.scrollHeight-window.innerHeight;
  prog.style.width=Math.min(100,y/h*100)+'%';
  document.body.classList.toggle('sc',y>20);
},{ passive:true });

// ── REVEAL ──
const io=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting)e.target.classList.add('in')}),{threshold:.1});
document.querySelectorAll('.rv,.rvl').forEach(el=>io.observe(el));

// ── COUNT UP ──
const co=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{
  if(e.isIntersecting){
    const el=e.target.querySelector('[data-count]');
    if(el&&!el.dataset.done){
      el.dataset.done='1';const t=+el.dataset.count;
      let n=0;const iv=setInterval(()=>{n=Math.min(n+Math.ceil(t/35),t);el.textContent=n+'+';if(n>=t)clearInterval(iv)},28);
    }
  }
}),{threshold:.4});
document.querySelectorAll('.stat').forEach(el=>co.observe(el));

// ── SERVICE CARD MOUSE ──
document.querySelectorAll('.svc-card').forEach(c=>{
  c.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{const r=c.getBoundingClientRect();c.style.setProperty('--mx',((e.clientX-r.left)/r.width*100)+'%');c.style.setProperty('--my',((e.clientY-r.top)/r.height*100)+'%')});
});

// ── MOBILE MENU ──
function toggleMenu(){const m=document.getElementById('mmenu');m.classList.toggle('open')}

// ── CONTACT FORM ──
function handleContact(e){
  e.preventDefault();
  const btn=document.getElementById('submitBtn'),msg=document.getElementById('formMsg');
  btn.textContent='Sending...';btn.disabled=true;

    msg.style.display='block';
    msg.textContent='Message sent! We will get back to you within 24 hours.';
    e.target.reset();btn.textContent='Send Message';btn.disabled=false;
  },1200);
}
</script>

-- ============================================================
-- SH Vertex Tech — Extended Products Schema
-- Run this in Supabase SQL Editor
-- This EXTENDS the existing schema. Safe to run on live DB.
-- ============================================================

-- Drop old products table if it exists (backup first if needed)
-- We rebuild it with full field support
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.products CASCADE;

CREATE TABLE public.products (
  id                  uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

  -- Core identity
  name                text NOT NULL,
  slug                text NOT NULL UNIQUE,          -- used for URL routing
  tagline             text,                          -- short punchy line under name
  description         text,                          -- main about paragraph
  icon_url            text,                          -- app icon (square)
  banner_url          text,                          -- hero/banner image (wide)

  -- Rich content
  features            jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
    -- [{title, description, icon}] array
  screenshots         jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
    -- [{url, caption}] array of Dropbox/external image URLs
  pros                jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
    -- ["string", "string"] array of pro points
  video_url           text,                          -- YouTube/Vimeo embed URL

  -- Pricing
  pricing_type        text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'free'
                      CHECK (pricing_type IN ('free','paid','subscription')),
  price_label         text,                          -- e.g. "LKR 1,500 / month" or "Free"
  pricing_tiers       jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
    -- [{name, price, features[], highlighted}] array

  -- Technical info
  min_android         text,                          -- e.g. "Android 8.0+"
  app_version         text,                          -- e.g. "v2.1.0"
  app_size            text,                          -- e.g. "~18 MB"
  app_code            text,                          -- internal code e.g. "simplibudget"
  tags                jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
    -- ["tag1", "tag2"] for display pills

  -- Distribution
  store_url           text,                          -- link into SHV Store / APK
  download_url        text,                          -- direct APK if applicable

  -- Status & display
  status              text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'live'
                      CHECK (status IN ('live','coming-soon','archived')),
  is_featured         boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  sort_order          integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

  -- Timestamps
  created_at          timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT timezone('utc', now()),
  updated_at          timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT timezone('utc', now())
);

-- Index for fast public queries
CREATE INDEX idx_products_status       ON public.products(status);
CREATE INDEX idx_products_sort         ON public.products(sort_order, created_at);
CREATE INDEX idx_products_slug         ON public.products(slug);

-- Auto-update updated_at
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_products_updated_at ON public.products;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_products_updated_at
  BEFORE UPDATE ON public.products
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE public.set_updated_at();

-- RLS: public can SELECT live/coming-soon products
ALTER TABLE public.products ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "products_public_read"  ON public.products;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "products_admin_all"    ON public.products;

-- Anyone can read live or coming-soon products
CREATE POLICY "products_public_read"
  ON public.products FOR SELECT
  USING (status IN ('live', 'coming-soon'));

-- Only the admin email can do full CRUD
-- (enforced via Supabase service role in the admin page,
--  but this extra policy blocks anon mutations)
CREATE POLICY "products_admin_all"
  ON public.products FOR ALL
  TO authenticated
  USING (true)
  WITH CHECK (true);

-- ============================================================
-- Seed: Migrate your existing products
-- Edit these rows with your real data, then uncomment to run
-- ============================================================
/*
INSERT INTO public.products (name, slug, tagline, description, pricing_type, price_label, status, sort_order, tags, app_code)
VALUES
  ('SimpliBudget', 'simplibudget', 'Personal finance, simplified.', 'A mobile-first budget tracker built for everyday financial control.', 'paid', 'LKR 1,500', 'live', 1, '["Finance","Android","Python"]', 'simplibudget'),
  ('Synapse', 'synapse', 'Operational productivity platform.', 'Project control, build support, and internal tooling for developers.', 'paid', 'LKR 2,000', 'live', 2, '["Productivity","Android"]', 'synapse'),
  ('Casino Tools Pro', 'casino-tools-pro', 'Advanced gambling analytics.', 'Simulation, analytics, and strategy tools for serious players.', 'paid', 'LKR 3,500', 'live', 3, '["Analytics","Android"]', 'casino-tools-pro'),
  ('Strategy Suite Pro', 'strategy-suite-pro', 'Risk analytics & simulation.', 'Advanced risk management and simulation toolkit.', 'paid', 'LKR 2,500', 'live', 4, '["Strategy","Android"]', 'strategy-suite-pro');
*/

-- ============================================================
-- Site Settings Table (for store APK URL and other globals)
-- Run this AFTER the products table above
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.site_settings (
  key   text PRIMARY KEY,
  value text NOT NULL,
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT timezone('utc', now())
);

-- Seed default store APK link
INSERT INTO public.site_settings (key, value)
VALUES ('store_apk_url', 'https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/y4abfqxqukefh9yc36bd2/app-debug.apk?rlkey=cfzlku12xn2c9hhpq61motj6q&st=bvtl35cg&dl=1')
ON CONFLICT (key) DO NOTHING;

-- RLS: public can read settings, only authenticated can write
ALTER TABLE public.site_settings ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "settings_public_read" ON public.site_settings;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "settings_admin_write" ON public.site_settings;

CREATE POLICY "settings_public_read"
  ON public.site_settings FOR SELECT
  USING (true);

CREATE POLICY "settings_admin_write"
  ON public.site_settings FOR ALL
  TO authenticated
  USING (true)
  WITH CHECK (true);

DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md.html:
# SH Vertex Website v2 — Deployment Guide

## Files in this package

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `index.html` | Main homepage — full redesign |
| `products.html` | Dynamic product catalogue (Supabase-driven) |
| `store.html` | SHV Store download page |
| `account.html` | Account portal — all Supabase logic preserved |
| `future-products.html` | Roadmap page (loads coming-soon from DB) |
| `admin.html` | **NEW** Product admin dashboard |
| `shvertex_products_schema.sql` | **NEW** Extended Supabase schema — run this first |
| `shv-supabase-config.js` | Supabase config — UNCHANGED |
| `shv-account-common.js` | Account helper JS — UNCHANGED |

## DELETE from your repo (replaced by admin dashboard)
- `casino-tools-pro.html`
- `synapse.html`
- `simplibudget.html`
- `strategy-suite-pro.html`
- `shv-hub-7x9.html`

---

## Step 1 — Run the new Supabase schema

1. Go to your Supabase project → **SQL Editor**
2. Paste the full contents of `shvertex_products_schema.sql`
3. Click **Run**
4. Then uncomment and edit the seed INSERT block to migrate your existing products

## Step 2 — Deploy to GitHub

```bash
# Push all new files to your repo
git add .
git commit -m "v2 redesign — new admin dashboard, dynamic products catalogue"
git push
```

## Step 3 — Access the Admin Dashboard

- URL: `https://shvertex.online/admin.html`
- Sign in with your **existing Supabase admin email + password**
- The dashboard auto-detects your session — no separate admin account needed

## Step 4 — Add your products via the dashboard

1. Go to `admin.html` → **Add Product**
2. Fill in name, description, pricing, tags, features, pros
3. For images: upload to Dropbox → Share → Copy link → change `?dl=0` to `?raw=1` → paste in Icon URL or Screenshot URL
4. Hit **Save Product**
5. It appears instantly on `products.html`

## Admin Dashboard URL (keep private)
```
https://shvertex.online/admin.html
```
> Tip: You can rename this file to something less guessable (e.g. `shv-control-9x7.html`) for security by obscurity.

---

## Notes for Phase 2 (Kotlin app integration)
- The admin uses standard Supabase REST API (`products` table)
- Your Kotlin store app can read/write the same table using the same Supabase project
- All fields are designed to be read by both web and mobile
- `app_code` field links a product to its app logic in the store app

---

## Step 1b — Run the site_settings SQL (NEW)

The schema file now includes a `site_settings` table at the bottom.
Run the **same** `shvertex_products_schema.sql` file — it creates both tables in one go.

## Updating the Store APK link (going forward)

1. Go to `admin.html`
2. Click **Site Settings** in the left sidebar
3. Paste your new Dropbox APK URL (ending in `?dl=1`)
4. Click **Save Link**
5. Done — all 4 download buttons across the site update instantly

## New file added

SUPABASE_SETUP.md.html:
# SH Vertex Account + Supabase setup

This bundle turns the website account pages into a real Supabase-ready portal.

## 1. Create your Supabase project
- Create a new project in Supabase.
- In Authentication, enable Email + Password.

## 2. Configure URL settings
Set the Site URL to your deployed website root, for example:
- `https://shvertex.online`

Add Redirect URLs for the pages used by this portal, for example:
- `https://shvertex.online/dashboard.html`
- `https://shvertex.online/update-password.html`
- `https://www.shvertex.online/dashboard.html`
- `https://www.shvertex.online/update-password.html`
- local dev URLs if needed, such as `http://localhost:5500/dashboard.html` and `http://localhost:5500/update-password.html`

Do not test auth email redirects from `file://` pages opened directly from storage. Use a real hosted URL or a local web server.

## 3. Run the SQL schema
Open the SQL Editor in Supabase and run:
- `shvertex_supabase_schema.sql`

This creates:
- `profiles`
- `devices`
- `backups`
- private storage bucket `app-backups`
- RLS policies for each user to see only their own data

## 4. Add your Supabase client details to the website
Edit:
- `shv-supabase-config.js`

Replace the placeholders with your real values:
- `url`
- `publishableKey`

## 5. Upload the updated files
Upload the full bundle contents to your website hosting.

## 6. Test the flow
Recommended test order:
1. Create account
2. Confirm email if confirmation is enabled
3. Sign in
4. Open dashboard
5. Trigger forgot password
6. Complete password reset on `update-password.html`

## 7. First app integration target
Use **SimpliBudget** first.

Recommended backup storage path per file:
- `{user_id}/simplibudget/{device_id}/{timestamp}.backup.enc`

Recommended flow for the app later:
1. user signs in
2. app creates encrypted JSON/ZIP backup
3. app uploads file to `app-backups`
4. app inserts row into `public.backups`
5. app can later list and restore only that user's backups

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">

<title>SH Vertex Tech | Enterprise Engineering & Security</title>
<meta name="description" content="SH Vertex Tech — Enterprise-grade cyber security, Android/Python software, and premium web & visual design for modern businesses.">
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="./assets/site/favicon.png">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800&family=DM+Sans:wght@700;800;900&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
:root{
  --bg:#09090f;--bg2:#0d0d18;--bg3:#111120;
  --card:rgba(255,255,255,0.04);--card2:rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
  --border:rgba(255,255,255,0.08);--border2:rgba(255,255,255,0.14);
  --green:#4ade80;--blue:#60a5fa;--purple:#a78bfa;
  --amber:#fbbf24;--pink:#f472b6;--cyan:#22d3ee;
  --green-dim:rgba(74,222,128,0.1);--blue-dim:rgba(96,165,250,0.1);
  --purple-dim:rgba(167,139,250,0.1);--amber-dim:rgba(251,191,36,0.1);
  --pink-dim:rgba(244,114,182,0.1);--cyan-dim:rgba(34,211,238,0.1);
  --text:#f1f0ed;--text2:#a8a49f;--text3:#5c5955;
  --mono:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;--display:'DM Sans',sans-serif;--body:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif;
  /* legacy aliases for JS/modal compatibility */
  --accent:#4ade80;--accent2:#22d3ee;--muted:rgba(241,240,237,0.45);--dim:rgba(241,240,237,0.18);
  --surface:rgba(255,255,255,0.025);
}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:var(--body);overflow-x:hidden;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;cursor:none}

/* ── CURSOR ── */
#cur{position:fixed;width:10px;height:10px;background:var(--green);border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;z-index:9999;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);mix-blend-mode:screen;transition:width .15s,height .15s}
#cur-ring{position:fixed;width:36px;height:36px;border:1px solid rgba(74,222,128,.32);border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;z-index:9998;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);transition:all .14s ease}

/* ── CANVAS ── */
#cv{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;opacity:.55;pointer-events:none}

/* ── NOISE ── */
body::before{content:'';position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;opacity:.22;
background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 200 200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.85' numOctaves='4' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23n)' opacity='0.04'/%3E%3C/svg%3E")}

/* ── PROGRESS ── */
.prog{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;height:2px;width:0;z-index:200;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--green),var(--cyan));box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(74,222,128,.5);transition:width .1s linear}

/* ── NAV ── */
nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:100;padding:16px 52px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;background:rgba(9,9,15,.82);backdrop-filter:blur(24px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);transition:all .3s}
body.sc nav{background:rgba(9,9,15,.95);border-color:var(--border2)}
.logo{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--text);text-decoration:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.logo-badge{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--green),var(--cyan));width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:8px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;color:#000;flex-shrink:0}
.logo-img{height:30px;width:auto;flex-shrink:0;object-fit:contain}
.nav-links{display:flex;gap:2px;align-items:center}
.nav-links a{font-family:var(--body);font-size:13px;font-weight:500;padding:8px 13px;border-radius:7px;color:var(--text2);text-decoration:none;transition:all .2s}
.nav-links a:hover{color:var(--text);background:var(--card2)}
.nav-links a.act{color:var(--green);background:var(--green-dim)}
.nav-cta{font-family:var(--body);font-size:13px;font-weight:700;padding:10px 22px;border-radius:8px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--green),var(--cyan));color:#000;text-decoration:none;transition:opacity .2s,transform .2s;box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(74,222,128,.25)}
.nav-cta:hover{opacity:.88;transform:translateY(-1px)}
.nav-cta span{position:relative;z-index:1}
.mbtn{display:none;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:10px 16px;border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text2);background:transparent;cursor:none;border-radius:7px;transition:all .2s}
.mmenu{display:none;position:fixed;top:65px;left:0;right:0;z-index:99;background:rgba(9,9,15,.97);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);backdrop-filter:blur(24px);padding:16px;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
.mmenu.open{display:flex}
.mmenu a{font-family:var(--body);font-size:13px;font-weight:500;padding:13px 16px;border-radius:8px;color:var(--text2);text-decoration:none;transition:all .2s}
.mmenu a:hover,.mmenu a.act{color:var(--green);background:var(--green-dim)}
@media(max-width:900px){nav{padding:14px 20px}.nav-links,.nav-cta{display:none}.mbtn{display:block}}

/* ── HERO ── */
.hero{position:relative;z-index:2;min-height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding:130px 52px 80px;overflow:hidden}
.hero::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse 65% 75% at 50% 50%,transparent 30%,var(--bg) 100%);pointer-events:none}

/* gradient orbs */
.orb{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(110px);pointer-events:none;z-index:0}
.orb1{width:600px;height:500px;background:rgba(74,222,128,.06);top:-5%;left:-8%}
.orb2{width:400px;height:400px;background:rgba(96,165,250,.05);top:15%;right:-5%}
.orb3{width:300px;height:300px;background:rgba(167,139,250,.04);bottom:5%;left:35%}

/* shield */
.shield-wrap{position:absolute;top:50%;right:4%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:520px;height:520px;perspective:900px;pointer-events:none;z-index:0}
.shield-3d{width:100%;height:100%;transform-style:preserve-3d;animation:sfloat 7s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes sfloat{0%,100%{transform:rotateX(6deg) rotateY(-8deg) translateY(0)}33%{transform:rotateX(-3deg) rotateY(12deg) translateY(-20px)}66%{transform:rotateX(8deg) rotateY(-14deg) translateY(-10px)}}
.sring{position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotateX(72deg);animation:rpulse 3s ease-in-out infinite}
.sring1{width:340px;height:340px;border-color:rgba(74,222,128,.14);animation-delay:0s}
.sring2{width:440px;height:440px;border-color:rgba(34,211,238,.08);animation-delay:.9s}
.sring3{width:540px;height:540px;border-color:rgba(74,222,128,.04);animation-delay:1.8s}
@keyframes rpulse{0%,100%{opacity:.5;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotateX(72deg) scale(1)}50%{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotateX(72deg) scale(1.05)}}

.hero-content{position:relative;z-index:3;max-width:680px}

.hero-full-logo{height:52px;width:auto;max-width:320px;object-fit:contain;margin-bottom:24px;opacity:.95;display:block}
.hero-eye{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:rgba(74,222,128,.08);border:1px solid rgba(74,222,128,.18);border-radius:100px;padding:6px 16px;margin-bottom:26px;opacity:0;animation:riseUp .6s ease .2s forwards}
.hero-eye-dot{width:6px;height:6px;background:var(--green);border-radius:50%;animation:grnpulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;flex-shrink:0}
@keyframes grnpulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(74,222,128,.5)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(74,222,128,0)}}
.hero-eye span{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--green)}

.hero-title{font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(52px,7vw,100px);font-weight:800;line-height:.93;letter-spacing:-.04em;margin-bottom:24px;opacity:0;animation:riseUp .8s ease .4s forwards}
.hero-title .stroke{color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:1.5px rgba(74,222,128,.4)}
.hero-title .glt{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--green),var(--cyan));-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 28px rgba(74,222,128,.35))}

.hero-sub{font-size:16px;line-height:1.8;color:var(--text2);max-width:520px;margin-bottom:36px;opacity:0;animation:riseUp .7s ease .6s forwards;font-weight:400}
.hero-sub strong{color:var(--text);font-weight:600}

.hero-btns{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;opacity:0;animation:riseUp .6s ease .8s forwards}
.btn-p{font-family:var(--body);font-size:14px;font-weight:700;padding:14px 28px;border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--green),var(--cyan));color:#000;text-decoration:none;transition:all .25s;box-shadow:0 4px 24px rgba(74,222,128,.28);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.btn-p::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-50%;left:-60%;width:40%;height:200%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);transform:skewX(-18deg);animation:shine 3.5s ease-in-out 1.5s infinite}
@keyframes shine{0%{left:-60%}100%{left:160%}}
.btn-p:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 8px 36px rgba(74,222,128,.4)}
.btn-p .arr{transition:transform .2s}
.btn-p:hover .arr{transform:translateX(4px)}
.btn-g{font-family:var(--body);font-size:14px;font-weight:600;padding:13px 26px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--border2);color:var(--text2);text-decoration:none;transition:all .25s;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;cursor:none}
.btn-g:hover{background:var(--card2);color:var(--text);border-color:var(--border2);transform:translateY(-1px)}

/* trust strip */
.hero-trust{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:36px;opacity:0;animation:riseUp .6s ease 1s forwards}
.trust-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:13px;color:var(--text3);font-weight:500}

/* hero ticker */
.hero-ticker{position:relative;z-index:3;margin-top:52px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0;border-top:1px solid var(--border);padding-top:22px;overflow:hidden;opacity:0;animation:fadeIn .7s ease 1.1s forwards}
.ticker-lbl{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text3);white-space:nowrap;padding-right:22px;border-right:1px solid var(--border);flex-shrink:0}
.ticker-wrap{overflow:hidden;flex:1}
.ticker-inner{display:flex;gap:48px;animation:tick 24s linear infinite;white-space:nowrap}
.ticker-inner span{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--text3);text-transform:uppercase;flex-shrink:0}
.ticker-inner span.hi{color:var(--green)}
@keyframes tick{from{transform:translateX(0)}to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}

@media(max-width:900px){.hero{padding:110px 20px 60px}.shield-wrap{display:none}.hero-title{font-size:52px}}

/* ── STATS ── */
.stats{position:relative;z-index:2;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:1px;background:var(--border);border-top:1px solid var(--border);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.stat{background:var(--bg2);padding:28px 30px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:background .3s}
.stat::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform .4s ease}
.stat:nth-child(1)::before{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--green),var(--cyan))}
.stat:nth-child(2)::before{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--blue),var(--purple))}

@media(max-width:700px){.stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.stat{padding:22px 20px}.stat-n{font-size:36px}}

async function submitToSupabase() {
  const nameVal = document.getElementById('asstName').value.trim();

<script>
// ── CURSOR ──
const cur=document.getElementById('cur'),ring=document.getElementById('cur-ring');
let mx=0,my=0,rx=0,ry=0;
document.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{mx=e.clientX;my=e.clientY;cur.style.left=mx+'px';cur.style.top=my+'px'});
(function anim(){rx+=(mx-rx)*.13;ry+=(my-ry)*.13;ring.style.left=rx+'px';ring.style.top=ry+'px';requestAnimationFrame(anim)})();
document.querySelectorAll('a,button,.svc-card,.stat,.why-card,.cert-badge,.eng-card,.asst-chip,.asst-btn,.asst-close,.btn-g,.contact-channel').forEach(el=>{
  el.addEventListener('mouseenter',()=>{cur.style.width='18px';cur.style.height='18px';ring.style.width='50px';ring.style.height='50px';ring.style.borderColor='rgba(74,222,128,.6)'});
  el.addEventListener('mouseleave',()=>{cur.style.width='10px';cur.style.height='10px';ring.style.width='36px';ring.style.height='36px';ring.style.borderColor='rgba(74,222,128,.32)'});
});

// ── PARTICLE NETWORK ──
const cv=document.getElementById('cv'),ctx=cv.getContext('2d');
let W,H,pts=[];
const N=85,MAX=135;
const PCOLS=['rgba(74,222,128,','rgba(96,165,250,','rgba(167,139,250,','rgba(34,211,238,'];
function resize(){W=cv.width=window.innerWidth;H=cv.height=window.innerHeight}
resize();window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{resize();init()});
function init(){pts=[];for(let i=0;i<N;i++)pts.push({x:Math.random()*W,y:Math.random()*H,vx:(Math.random()-.5)*.38,vy:(Math.random()-.5)*.38,r:Math.random()*1.4+.4,c:PCOLS[Math.floor(Math.random()*PCOLS.length)]})}
init();
let mp={x:-999,y:-999};
document.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{mp.x=e.clientX;mp.y=e.clientY});
function draw(){
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  pts.forEach(p=>{
    p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;
    if(p.x<0||p.x>W)p.vx*=-1;if(p.y<0||p.y>H)p.vy*=-1;
    const dx=mp.x-p.x,dy=mp.y-p.y,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
    if(d<200){p.vx+=dx/d*.01;p.vy+=dy/d*.01}
    const s=Math.sqrt(p.vx*p.vx+p.vy*p.vy);if(s>.75){p.vx/=s*.75;p.vy/=s*.75}
  });
  for(let i=0;i<pts.length;i++){
    for(let j=i+1;j<pts.length;j++){
      const a=pts[i],b=pts[j],dx=a.x-b.x,dy=a.y-b.y,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
      if(d<MAX){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(a.x,a.y);ctx.lineTo(b.x,b.y);ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(255,255,255,${(1-d/MAX)*.1})`;ctx.lineWidth=.5;ctx.stroke()}
    }
    const pm=pts[i],dx=pm.x-mp.x,dy=pm.y-mp.y,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
    if(d<180){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(pm.x,pm.y);ctx.lineTo(mp.x,mp.y);ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(74,222,128,${(1-d/180)*.55})`;ctx.lineWidth=.8;ctx.stroke()}
  }
  pts.forEach(p=>{ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle=p.c+'.65)';ctx.fill()});
  requestAnimationFrame(draw);
}
draw();

// ── SCROLL PROGRESS ──
const prog=document.getElementById('prog');
window.addEventListener('scroll',()=>{
  const y=window.scrollY,h=document.documentElement.scrollHeight-window.innerHeight;
  prog.style.width=Math.min(100,y/h*100)+'%';
  document.body.classList.toggle('sc',y>20);
},{passive:true});

// ── REVEAL ──
const io=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting)e.target.classList.add('in')}),{threshold:.1});
document.querySelectorAll('.rv,.rvl').forEach(el=>io.observe(el));

// ── COUNT UP ──
const co=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{
  if(e.isIntersecting){
    const el=e.target.querySelector('[data-count]');
    if(el&&!el.dataset.done){
      el.dataset.done='1';const t=+el.dataset.count;
      let n=0;const iv=setInterval(()=>{n=Math.min(n+Math.ceil(t/35),t);el.textContent=n+'+';if(n>=t)clearInterval(iv)},28);
    }
  }
}),{threshold:.4});
document.querySelectorAll('.stat').forEach(el=>co.observe(el));

// ── SERVICE CARD MOUSE GLOW ──
document.querySelectorAll('.svc-card').forEach(c=>{
  c.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{const r=c.getBoundingClientRect();c.style.setProperty('--mx',((e.clientX-r.left)/r.width*100)+'%');c.style.setProperty('--my',((e.clientY-r.top)/r.height*100)+'%')});
});

// ── MOBILE MENU ──
function toggleMenu(){document.getElementById('mmenu').classList.toggle('open')}

// ── INSTALL GUIDE ──
let igCurrent=0;const IG_TOTAL=5;
const FALLBACK_APK='https://github.com/cryptowolfman97/shvertex-website/releases/download/v1.0/app-debug.apk';
function getApkUrl(){return(window.SHV_APK_URL&&window.SHV_APK_URL!=='#')?window.SHV_APK_URL:FALLBACK_APK}
function openInstallGuide(){igCurrent=0;igRender();document.getElementById('igOverlay').classList.add('open');document.body.style.overflow='hidden'}
function closeInstallGuide(){document.getElementById('igOverlay').classList.remove('open');document.body.style.overflow=''}
function igOverlayClick(e){if(e.target===document.getElementById('igOverlay'))closeInstallGuide()}
function igStep(dir){
  const next=igCurrent+dir;
  if(next<0||next>IG_TOTAL)return;
  if(next===IG_TOTAL){
    const url=getApkUrl();const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.target='_blank';a.rel='noopener noreferrer';
    document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();document.body.removeChild(a);closeInstallGuide();return;
  }
  igCurrent=next;igRender();
}
function igRender(){
  document.querySelectorAll('.ig-panel').forEach((p,i)=>p.classList.toggle('active',i===igCurrent));
  document.querySelectorAll('.ig-step-dot').forEach((d,i)=>{d.classList.remove('active','done');if(i===igCurrent)d.classList.add('active');else if(i<igCurrent)d.classList.add('done')});
  document.getElementById('igStepNum').textContent=igCurrent+1;
  document.getElementById('igPrevBtn').disabled=igCurrent===0;
  const nb=document.getElementById('igNextBtn');
  nb.textContent=igCurrent===IG_TOTAL-1?'⬇ Download Now':'Next →';
}
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  if(!document.getElementById('igOverlay').classList.contains('open'))return;
  if(e.key==='Escape')closeInstallGuide();
  if(e.key==='ArrowRight')igStep(1);if(e.key==='ArrowLeft')igStep(-1);
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

shvertex_products_schema.sql.html:
-- ============================================================
-- SH Vertex Tech — Extended Products Schema
-- Run this in Supabase SQL Editor
-- This EXTENDS the existing schema. Safe to run on live DB.
-- ============================================================

-- Drop old products table if it exists (backup first if needed)
-- We rebuild it with full field support
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.products CASCADE;

CREATE TABLE public.products (
  id                  uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

  -- Core identity
  name                text NOT NULL,
  slug                text NOT NULL UNIQUE,          -- used for URL routing
  tagline             text,                          -- short punchy line under name
  description         text,                          -- main about paragraph
  icon_url            text,                          -- app icon (square)
  banner_url          text,                          -- hero/banner image (wide)

  -- Rich content
  features            jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
    -- [{title, description, icon}] array
  screenshots         jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
    -- [{url, caption}] array of Dropbox/external image URLs
  pros                jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
    -- ["string", "string"] array of pro points
  video_url           text,                          -- YouTube/Vimeo embed URL

  -- Pricing
  pricing_type        text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'free'
                      CHECK (pricing_type IN ('free','paid','subscription')),
  price_label         text,                          -- e.g. "LKR 1,500 / month" or "Free"
  pricing_tiers       jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
    -- [{name, price, features[], highlighted}] array

  -- Technical info
  min_android         text,                          -- e.g. "Android 8.0+"
  app_version         text,                          -- e.g. "v2.1.0"
  app_size            text,                          -- e.g. "~18 MB"
  app_code            text,                          -- internal code e.g. "simplibudget"
  tags                jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
    -- ["tag1", "tag2"] for display pills

  -- Distribution
  store_url           text,                          -- link into SHV Store / APK
  download_url        text,                          -- direct APK if applicable

  -- Status & display
  status              text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'live'
                      CHECK (status IN ('live','coming-soon','archived')),
  is_featured         boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  sort_order          integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

  -- Timestamps
  created_at          timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT timezone('utc', now()),
  updated_at          timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT timezone('utc', now())
);

-- Index for fast public queries
CREATE INDEX idx_products_status       ON public.products(status);
CREATE INDEX idx_products_sort         ON public.products(sort_order, created_at);
CREATE INDEX idx_products_slug         ON public.products(slug);

-- Auto-update updated_at
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_products_updated_at ON public.products;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_products_updated_at
  BEFORE UPDATE ON public.products
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE public.set_updated_at();

-- RLS: public can SELECT live/coming-soon products
ALTER TABLE public.products ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "products_public_read"  ON public.products;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "products_admin_all"    ON public.products;

-- Anyone can read live or coming-soon products
CREATE POLICY "products_public_read"
  ON public.products FOR SELECT
  USING (status IN ('live', 'coming-soon'));

-- Only the admin email can do full CRUD
-- (enforced via Supabase service role in the admin page,
--  but this extra policy blocks anon mutations)
CREATE POLICY "products_admin_all"
  ON public.products FOR ALL
  TO authenticated
  USING (true)
  WITH CHECK (true);

-- ============================================================
-- Seed: Migrate your existing products
-- Edit these rows with your real data, then uncomment to run
-- ============================================================
/*
INSERT INTO public.products (name, slug, tagline, description, pricing_type, price_label, status, sort_order, tags, app_code)
VALUES
  ('SimpliBudget', 'simplibudget', 'Personal finance, simplified.', 'A mobile-first budget tracker built for everyday financial control.', 'paid', 'LKR 1,500', 'live', 1, '["Finance","Android","Python"]', 'simplibudget'),
  ('Synapse', 'synapse', 'Operational productivity platform.', 'Project control, build support, and internal tooling for developers.', 'paid', 'LKR 2,000', 'live', 2, '["Productivity","Android"]', 'synapse'),
  ('Casino Tools Pro', 'casino-tools-pro', 'Advanced gambling analytics.', 'Simulation, analytics, and strategy tools for serious players.', 'paid', 'LKR 3,500', 'live', 3, '["Analytics","Android"]', 'casino-tools-pro'),
  ('Strategy Suite Pro', 'strategy-suite-pro', 'Risk analytics & simulation.', 'Advanced risk management and simulation toolkit.', 'paid', 'LKR 2,500', 'live', 4, '["Strategy","Android"]', 'strategy-suite-pro');
*/

-- ============================================================
-- Site Settings Table (for store APK URL and other globals)
-- Run this AFTER the products table above
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.site_settings (
  key   text PRIMARY KEY,
  value text NOT NULL,
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT timezone('utc', now())
);

-- Seed default store APK link
INSERT INTO public.site_settings (key, value)
VALUES ('store_apk_url', 'https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/y4abfqxqukefh9yc36bd2/app-debug.apk?rlkey=cfzlku12xn2c9hhpq61motj6q&st=bvtl35cg&dl=1')
ON CONFLICT (key) DO NOTHING;

-- RLS: public can read settings, only authenticated can write
ALTER TABLE public.site_settings ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "settings_public_read" ON public.site_settings;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "settings_admin_write" ON public.site_settings;

CREATE POLICY "settings_public_read"
  ON public.site_settings FOR SELECT
  USING (true);

CREATE POLICY "settings_admin_write"
  ON public.site_settings FOR ALL
  TO authenticated
  USING (true)
  WITH CHECK (true);

<!DOCTYPE html>

<style>
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
:root{
  --bg:#09090f;--bg2:#0d0d18;--card:rgba(255,255,255,0.04);--card2:rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
  --border:rgba(255,255,255,0.08);--border2:rgba(255,255,255,0.14);

}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:var(--body);overflow-x:hidden;max-width:100vw;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;cursor:none}

body::before{content:'';position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;opacity:.22;background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 200 200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.85' numOctaves='4' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23n)' opacity='0.04'/%3E%3C/svg%3E")}

/* HERO */
.hero{position:relative;z-index:2;min-height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:120px 52px 80px;gap:60px;flex-wrap:wrap}
@media(max-width:900px){.hero{padding:110px 20px 60px;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;overflow-x:hidden;width:100%}.hero-left{width:100%;min-width:0}.hero-right{width:100%;max-width:100%;display:flex;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden}.phone-wrap{width:200px;max-width:90vw}}

.hero-title{font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(42px,6vw,84px);font-weight:800;line-height:.93;letter-spacing:-.04em;margin-bottom:22px}
.hero-title .glt{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--green),var(--cyan));-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text}

.dl-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;font-family:var(--body);font-size:15px;font-weight:700;padding:16px 32px;border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--green),var(--cyan));color:#000;text-decoration:none;transition:all .25s;box-shadow:0 6px 28px rgba(74,222,128,.3);position:relative;overflow:hidden;cursor:none}
.dl-btn::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-50%;left:-60%;width:40%;height:200%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);transform:skewX(-18deg);animation:shine 3.5s ease-in-out 1s infinite}

/* FEATURES */
.section{position:relative;z-index:2;padding:80px 52px}
@media(max-width:900px){.section{padding:60px 20px}}
.sec-tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text3);margin-bottom:14px;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase}

.rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(28px);transition:opacity .65s ease,transform .65s ease}.rv.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
/* INSTALL GUIDE MODAL */
.ig-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:600;background:rgba(0,0,0,.88);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px}
.ig-overlay.open{display:flex}
.ig-modal{width:100%;max-width:560px;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid rgba(74,222,128,.2);border-radius:18px;position:relative;max-height:92vh;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.ig-modal::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--green),transparent);border-radius:18px 18px 0 0}

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2/dist/umd/supabase.min.js"></script>
<script src="./shv-supabase-config.js"></script>
<script>
const cur=document.getElementById('cur'),ring=document.getElementById('cur-ring');
let mx=0,my=0,rx=0,ry=0;
document.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{mx=e.clientX;my=e.clientY;cur.style.left=mx+'px';cur.style.top=my+'px'});
(function a(){rx+=(mx-rx)*.13;ry+=(my-ry)*.13;ring.style.left=rx+'px';ring.style.top=ry+'px';requestAnimationFrame(a)})();
document.querySelectorAll('a,button').forEach(el=>{
  el.addEventListener('mouseenter',()=>{cur.style.width='18px';cur.style.height='18px'});
  el.addEventListener('mouseleave',()=>{cur.style.width='10px';cur.style.height='10px'});
});
const cv=document.getElementById('cv'),ctx=cv.getContext('2d');let W,H,pts=[];
const PCOLS=['rgba(74,222,128,','rgba(96,165,250,','rgba(167,139,250,','rgba(34,211,238,'];
function resize(){W=cv.width=window.innerWidth;H=cv.height=window.innerHeight}resize();window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{resize();init()});
function init(){pts=[];for(let i=0;i<55;i++)pts.push({x:Math.random()*W,y:Math.random()*H,vx:(Math.random()-.5)*.3,vy:(Math.random()-.5)*.3,r:Math.random()*1.2+.3,c:PCOLS[Math.floor(Math.random()*PCOLS.length)]})}init();
let mp={x:-999,y:-999};document.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{mp.x=e.clientX;mp.y=e.clientY});
function draw(){ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);pts.forEach(p=>{p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;if(p.x<0||p.x>W)p.vx*=-1;if(p.y<0||p.y>H)p.vy*=-1});
for(let i=0;i<pts.length;i++){for(let j=i+1;j<pts.length;j++){const a=pts[i],b=pts[j],dx=a.x-b.x,dy=a.y-b.y,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);if(d<120){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(a.x,a.y);ctx.lineTo(b.x,b.y);ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(255,255,255,${(1-d/120)*.1})`;ctx.lineWidth=.5;ctx.stroke()}}
const pm=pts[i],dx=pm.x-mp.x,dy=pm.y-mp.y,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);if(d<160){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(pm.x,pm.y);ctx.lineTo(mp.x,mp.y);ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(74,222,128,${(1-d/160)*.55})`;ctx.lineWidth=.8;ctx.stroke()}}
pts.forEach(p=>{ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle=p.c+'.6)';ctx.fill()});requestAnimationFrame(draw)}draw();
window.addEventListener('scroll',()=>{const y=window.scrollY,h=document.documentElement.scrollHeight-window.innerHeight;document.getElementById('prog').style.width=Math.min(100,y/h*100)+'%';document.body.classList.toggle('sc',y>20)},{passive:true});
const io=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting)e.target.classList.add('in')}),{threshold:.1});
document.querySelectorAll('.rv').forEach(el=>io.observe(el));
// INSTALL GUIDE (preserved exactly)
let igCurrent=0;const IG_TOTAL=5;
const FALLBACK_APK='https://github.com/cryptowolfman97/shvertex-website/releases/download/v1.0/app-debug.apk';
function getApkUrl(){return(window.SHV_APK_URL&&window.SHV_APK_URL!=='#')?window.SHV_APK_URL:FALLBACK_APK}
function openInstallGuide(){igCurrent=0;igRender();document.getElementById('igOverlay').classList.add('open');document.body.style.overflow='hidden'}
function closeInstallGuide(){document.getElementById('igOverlay').classList.remove('open');document.body.style.overflow=''}
function igOverlayClick(e){if(e.target===document.getElementById('igOverlay'))closeInstallGuide()}
function igStep(dir){
  const next=igCurrent+dir;if(next<0||next>IG_TOTAL)return;
  if(next===IG_TOTAL){const url=getApkUrl();const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.target='_blank';a.rel='noopener noreferrer';document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();document.body.removeChild(a);closeInstallGuide();return;}
  igCurrent=next;igRender();
}
function igRender(){
  document.querySelectorAll('.ig-panel').forEach((p,i)=>p.classList.toggle('active',i===igCurrent));
  document.querySelectorAll('.ig-step-dot').forEach((d,i)=>{d.classList.remove('active','done');if(i===igCurrent)d.classList.add('active');else if(i<igCurrent)d.classList.add('done')});
  document.getElementById('igStepNum').textContent=igCurrent+1;
  document.getElementById('igPrevBtn').disabled=igCurrent===0;
  document.getElementById('igNextBtn').textContent=igCurrent===IG_TOTAL-1?'⬇ Download Now':'Next →';
}
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(!document.getElementById('igOverlay').classList.contains('open'))return;if(e.key==='Escape')closeInstallGuide();if(e.key==='ArrowRight')igStep(1);if(e.key==='ArrowLeft')igStep(-1)});
</script>
<script src="./shv-settings.js"></script>
</body>
